title: Submit descriptor
description: The reviewed change set as iCode is asked to take it. Archived under artifact kind `change-set`, which is NOT the IMPLEMENT phase artifact: that one is stored under kind `implement` and validated against change-set.schema.json. The two share a name and nothing else. These required fields plus optional submission_mode are the canonical bytes clients/icode_runtime.py rebuilds and compares before it will submit, so a field added here without adding it there makes the descriptor unsubmittable. The checks are on shape only: how an id is derived (revision_set_id is a sha256 of the revision set today) belongs to the code that derives it, not here.
